description: issue #864: the Core-only half of the value-position rule, and the byte-identical twin of `block-heads-not-values`. `spec/interaction-events.md:43-46` reserves `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click` ONLY within the Interaction & Events profile, so a Core-only program sees four ordinary names -- names nothing in THIS program declares, which is `ol-unknown-command` (`spec/tooling.md:181`), not the wrong-position `ol-bad-token` its twin reports for the very same bytes. That contrast is the whole point of the pair: it pins issue #864's rule as PROFILE-GATED rather than a blanket rejection, so a Core-only learner who writes `define every ... end` and then calls it keeps working (the declaration half of that promise is the older pair `block-heads-free-core-only` / `block-heads-reserved-under-profile`). This fixture asserts a NAME-visibility outcome, not a declaration one, so `spec/grammar.md:408`'s pending unconditional-built-in-names change (issue #841) has nothing here to invalidate. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
